text.converter: vic_convert2.py (stdlib zipfile + ElementTree over word/document.xml; kept outside the repository); from 2026-11-07, replacing vic_convert.py
text.conversion: The Word file was converted to UTF-8 plain text by Legalese Commons (vic_convert.py: stdlib zipfile and ElementTree over word/document.xml). The table of provisions, running heads and footers are dropped; the cover is kept as the file prints it (twice). Each provision starts on its own line with its number; paragraphs are indented two spaces a level; the register's marginal history notes are kept as "[Side note: ...]" lines before the provision they annotate; tables are "| a | b |" rows; Word equations are linearised in place; each embedded equation object or image is marked "[formula ...]" or "[image ...]" and transcribed in workplace-injury-rehabilitation-and-compensation-act-2013.formulas.md. The endnotes (amendment history) are kept. Nothing else is changed.
known_conversion_artefacts: the cover (version number, title, number, version date) appears twice at the head, as in the Word file
the "Note" and "Example" labels stand on their own line, unindented, before their text
multi-line formulas set as indented paragraphs keep their brackets but lose their alignment

reconverted_2026_11_07.why: vic_convert.py dropped every Word <w:sym> character with a code of F000 or more. The register sets some characters that way in the Symbol font: F0D7 its raised decimal point, F0B4 the multiplication sign, F02D the minus sign, F0B7 a bullet. vic_convert2.py maps them to Unicode · × − • (and Wingdings boxes to "[ ]").
reconverted_2026_11_07.what_changed: 18 lines, only by the restored characters: s 54(4) example ("84 per cent" now "8·4 per cent"); s 63(1)(c) and (3)(c) ("10 + [0278 (NAL 10)]" now "10 + [0·278 (NAL − 10)]"); s 211(2)(b)-(e) and s 212(b)-(d) (the multiplication signs in "(D – 10) × $9940" and the like, and "× 1·1"); s 213(1)(a)-(e) (the minus signs in "(T − 10)", "(10 − P)" and the like); Schedule 7 clause 1(2)(a) ("0033 per cent" now "0·033 per cent"). The notice header (first 9 lines) is kept exactly as deposited on 2026-11-06; line count and numbering are unchanged.
